title: A gentle choice offers fair regard
meaning: Your free choice to care for each other can offer fairness when consideration does not erase the actual consequences of an action.
text: Honest regard can remain warm even after an awkward action. In the physical position of Anahata, Strength expresses care through restraint of pressure, gentle actions and respect for vulnerability. The Lovers in energy bring a wish to choose meaningful closeness and remain present voluntarily. Justice in emotions offers clarity and acknowledged regard. Tenderness may be felt when a mistake does not become a description of a person, while its consequences need not be denied either. Involvement preserves both people’s dignity without deciding who now deserves more attention from the other.

For example, during dinner together one person accidentally spills sauce on the other’s favourite tablecloth. You contain an irritated reproach, calmly clear the excess and decide together how to attend to the cloth later. **Consideration can acknowledge consequences without humiliating a person.** Frustration remains allowed, and help requires no pretence that nothing happened. The meal can continue without turning an accident into a debt for a spoiled mood.

A wish to preserve closeness can lead to hiding disappointment completely. Outward gentleness then accumulates an unspoken bill, and fairness returns later as a demand for repayment. Alternatively, acknowledging consequences becomes a test of love through the amount of guilt displayed. Warmth remains in concrete responsibility and a free response. You can regret damage to an object and accept help without making the incident a measure of the whole connection’s worth.
